qs.q:
Earthrise

"'Earthrise' has become one of history's most influential images. It transformed our view of ourselves. It brought home the awareness that the world was a place we all share together."

According to the author, 'Earthrise' is important because…
A it is the first picture of the Earth.
B it is the most famous picture of the Earth.
C it changed the way people look at the Earth.
D it shows how fragile the Earth is.
opts: it is the first picture of the Earth.
it is the most famous picture of the Earth.
it changed the way people look at the Earth.
it shows how fragile the Earth is.

qs.q:
Earthrise

For the author, 'Earthrise' makes the Earth look…
A beautiful.
B helpless.

D small.

Earthrise

"Apollo 8 was originally meant only to check the tracking and communications equipment in low earth orbit."

The initial aim of the mission was…
A to test equipment.
B to test human endurance in space.
C to fly round the moon.
D to prepare for a moon landing.
opts: to test human endurance in space.
to prepare for a moon landing.

qs.q:
How Teenagers Consume Media

"The main reason teenagers listen to the radio is for music. (19) ___. As a result, most teenagers nowadays are not regular listeners to radio."

A They often choose what they will see when they get there.
B So they switch to another channel, or do something else.
C There are many radio stations devoted to playing popular music.
D This is because a credit card is required for such purchases.
E Usually, teenagers only use their phone for texting.
F However, they prefer to go onto online sites where they can choose the songs they want instead of getting what the DJ chooses.
G This is because there's always the risk of losing it.
H This is especially true for the ones that are distributed free on buses and trains.
opts: A — They often choose what they will see when they get there.
B — So they switch to another channel, or do something else.
C — There are many radio stations devoted to popular music.
D — A credit card is required for such purchases.
E — Teenagers only use their phone for texting.
F — They prefer online sites where they can choose songs instead of what the DJ chooses.
G — There's always the risk of losing it.
H — Especially true for ones distributed free on buses and trains.
